scope: Prospective old d8135a1 versus prepared-card/seat-local terminal kernels. F32 compact, one worker, four fixed fixtures. Descriptive implementation screen, not R1 acceptance or tiny-weight cancellation repair.
order: Case order river, turn, flop, narrow-river. Within each case run blocks 0..3; block zero is warmup. Old precedes new when (case-index + block) is even; otherwise new precedes old. Total 32 processes, 24 measured. Each case's three measured pairs cannot perfectly balance order; across cases each order occurs six times. No pilot, iteration adjustment, retry or case replacement.
correctness: All eight outputs per case must have identical original canonical.bin and state.bin bytes (also SHA256), all quality fields including EV/BR/NashConv bits, global combo IDs, counts/tree topology, normalized config, algorithm, rake and utility. All warmups count for correctness and remain retained; only measured blocks enter timing summaries. F32 only.
measurement: Old/new release builds and all samples must share one Linux x86_64 boot with four logical CPUs, full affinity, unrestricted or at least four-CPU quota, <=12GiB outer cgroup and swap.max=0. RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 and explicit --threads 1. No concurrent build, transfer or experiment. Solver run_seconds alone defines timing guards; setup/query/artifact time is excluded. Native wait4 peak RSS covers the full process; sampled summed process-tree RSS is separate and may miss peaks. Neither is solve-only RSS. Three pairs and short fixtures yield descriptive guardrails, not confidence intervals or cross-host performance guarantees.
retention: Self-contained original-byte payloads plus a path/SHA256 index. Source archives are read and verified without executing retained code. Compiler/Python binaries are identity-only; benchmark binaries, source archives, manifests, runner/protocol, build records, raw logs/samples and benchmark artifacts are retained. Source-after means recorded live rehash, not an independent filesystem snapshot.
failure: No automatic retry. On any execution, identity, quality or deadline failure stop, mark the exact remaining schedule skipped, retain raw evidence and report no adoption guard. Require at least timeout+20 seconds before starting a process. Prepare and measure are separate; external service must enforce the absolute deadline. A failed prepare cannot be resumed. Protocol and all counts/thresholds freeze before measurement.
